summary: A 100-foot steel tower erected in 1929 one mile west of Parkton; no later history found, and OpenStreetMap still has a lattice observation tower record named Parkton Lookout Tower, not confirmed as the same site.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source (the state biennial report quoted on the Forest Lookouts index) plus a January 1930 newspaper quote. No source after 1930 describes staffing, fires or the tower's fate; OpenStreetMap is the only current record. The 100-foot figure is the 1929 total with the cab floor not stated, so no height_m is recorded. The tnlandforms list gives the same coordinates as OpenStreetMap (34.90361, -79.02527) and an NGS ID, EB 2564, already in the record; the one-mile-west location was not checked against that point. Record agency was null; set from the index heading.
